description: Land Title Settlement Department - Atuthgama - Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511800
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various locations. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property ownership registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
